title: Erdős 374: classical square products of factorials
summary: Formalization of classical factorial-square constructions, exclusion of prime endpoints, existence of minimum representation cardinalities for composite endpoints, and the cutoff D_k = empty for k greater than six. The density question from Erdős problem 374 is defined but not proved. No mathematical novelty or solution of the density problem is claimed.

review.reason: Formalization of factorial-square constructions tied to an Erdős problem, with the density question left open.
